items.title: Inform landlord whether to extend lease
items.quote: Please tell us in writing by 16 December 2026 whether you would like to extend.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date by which a written reply is required: 16 December 2026. This is a private-law deadline stated directly as a date, not a period to be calculated, so it is used as written. 16 December 2026 is a Wednesday, a normal working day in NRW, so no weekend/holiday adjustment is needed.

warnings: The lease is a fixed-term contract ending 31 January 2027 with no stated automatic renewal; the landlord explicitly plans to hand over the apartment at the end of January if no reply is received, so no cancellation (cancel_by) is needed to end it — only a reply is needed to request an extension, and the letter does not state any notice period for an extension or whether an extended term would itself auto-renew.
